issue.title: How do I set a default selected item on USelectMenu?
issue.body: I'm building a settings page and want `USelectMenu` to start with one of the options already selected instead of showing the placeholder. I tried passing `model-value` but it didn't seem to do anything. Is there a prop for this, or do I need to set it manually with a ref? Would appreciate a pointer to the right docs page too.
issue.author: newuser22
